findings.note: Authored HB 3313 (86th session), which would add to a mail-ballot application the applicant's birth date and a Texas driver's license or DPS ID card number, else the last four digits of a Social Security number, else a statement that none was issued. Filed 2019-03-05; referred to the Elections committee 2019-03-18. Bill text: https://capitol.texas.gov/tlodocs/86R/billtext/html/HB03313I.htm
